laura: quick brainstorm / 'Code Camp Sprint' idea: 3 micro-tutorials + one tiny refapp + a mentor webinar. deliverables: launch post, tutorial cadence, refapp repo, webinar funnel, inbound routing. short plan below.

nick: love it. can we reuse tiny-refapp starter to speed things up?

zoe: i'll draft 3 labs (15-20m each). include reproducible prompts + a 2-line bench blurb. drafts due Fri.

ben: i'll scaffold the repo (MIT) with run-local.sh and a minimal README. ETA Tue.

laura: webinar format: 40m demo + 15m q&a. landing page gated + UTMs. anna can you own email drip? (cc @anna in follow-up)

marketing-bot: task created /tasks/8221 assigned to @laura @zoe @ben. review due Wed 09:00 PT.

nick: inbound routing: tag registrants `camp_interest`; if they complete >50% labs or click "talk to eng" route to SE queue.

zoe: content tree i plan to push:
``
/tutorials/code-camp/lab1-setup.md
/tutorials/code-camp/lab2-batching.md
/tutorials/code-camp/lab3-deploy.md
/refapps/code-camp/README.md
/benchmarks/camp-demo-blurb.md
```

ben: will add CONTRIBUTING.md for mentors and a tiny bench script `bench.sh`.

laura: metrics: landing views, signups, webinar attendance, lab completions, repo stars, MQLs. set dashboards in HubSpot + Amplitude.

laura: TL;DR: repo Tue, tutorials Fri, post review Wed, publish Thu, webinar 2w after publish. sync Tue 10:00 PT. :rocket:
